description: Batch version of route_task: give an ARRAY of plain-language sub-tasks and get the best live tool for EACH in one call — so a multi-step plan collapses N round-trips into one. Each result carries the tool's endpoint, input schema, example args, free/paid + how-to-pay, and fallbacks (compact by default to save tokens). Use this at the start of a multi-step task to plan every step at once.

category.description: Optional capability category to narrow all choices.

fallbacks.description: How many backup tools per sub-task (default 5, max 10).

maxPricePerCall.description: Cap per-call price in USD; paid tools above this are excluded (applies to every sub-task).

requireAutomatable.description: Only tools payable autonomously (free or x402).

name: route_tasks
